newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BNB to pay 1,740 Bfr net dividend March 1.
newsitem.headline: BNB to pay 1,740 Bfr net dividend March 1.

text.p: The Belgian National Bank (BNB) said on Wednesday it had fixed its 1996 net dividend at 1,740 Belgian francs, up from 1,705 francs a year earlier.
The dividend, equivalent to 2,320 francs gross, would be payable from March 1, the central bank said in a statement. Its share would go ex-dividend on February 26.
The Belgian National Bank, along with the Greek and Swiss central banks, is one of the world's few listed central banks.
Fifty percent of its shares are in the hands of the public.
The Belgian government has control of the bank and the remaining 50 percent.
